s0101.literal: An Prefecture suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of notes from the Hejian salt levy were issued for relief.
s0101.idiomatic: An Prefecture suffered famine; 10,000 ingots of notes from the Hejian salt levy were issued for relief.

s0102.literal: In Dongchang and Jining 2 circuits and Cao, Pu, and other prefectures, worms all ate mulberry leaves.
s0102.idiomatic: In Dongchang and Jining 2 circuits and Cao, Pu, and other prefectures, worms all ate mulberry leaves.

s0103.literal: Fifth month, on jisi new moon, Gaochang prince Zangji died; his younger brother Taipingnu succeeded to the position.
s0103.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jisi new moon, Gaochang prince Zangji died; his younger brother Taipingnu succeeded to the position.

s0104.literal: On renshen day, twenty-three relay stations including Mulin and Qili were relieved — two shi of grain per person.
s0104.idiomatic: On renshen day, 23 relay stations including Mulin and Qili were relieved — 2 shi of grain per person.

s0105.literal: On guiyou day, Mars transgressed the Well.
s0105.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Mars transgressed the Well.

s0106.literal: Yan Temür was granted a feast at the Flowing Cup Pool.
s0106.idiomatic: Yan Temür was granted a feast at the Flowing Cup Pool.

s0107.literal: Dali, Zhongqing, and other routes of Yunnan suffered great famine; one hundred thousand ingots of notes were issued for relief.
s0107.idiomatic: Dali, Zhongqing, and other routes of Yunnan suffered great famine; 100,000 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

s0108.literal: On jiaxu day, Shangshe Temple was promoted to rank 3b.
s0108.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Shangshe Temple was promoted to rank 3b.

s0109.literal: Sadi requested that from the Emperor's accession onward the great pattern of firm yielding, the back-and-forth memorials and responses, and the rest — instructions, commissions, and Yan Temür's declarations of loyal service — be fully recorded; Drolai was ordered to continue compiling them into the book 《Mongol Tuoba Chiyan》, to be placed in the Kuizhang Pavilion — granted.
s0109.idiomatic: Sadi requested that from the Emperor's accession onward the great pattern of firm yielding, the back-and-forth memorials and responses, and the rest — instructions, commissions, and Yan Temür's declarations of loyal service — be fully recorded; Drolai was ordered to continue compiling them into the book 《Mongol Tuoba Chiyan》, to be placed in the Kuizhang Pavilion — granted.

s0110.literal: Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator To'on was granted a gold tiger tally.
s0110.idiomatic: Huguang Branch Secretariat associate administrator To'on was granted a gold tiger tally.

s0111.literal: Guo Shuan of Baoding Route was commended for filial conduct, and Lingbao, wife of Tantai, was commended for worthy filial piety.
s0111.idiomatic: Guo Shuan of Baoding Route was commended for filial conduct, and Lingbao, wife of Tantai, was commended for worthy filial piety.

s0112.literal: On wuyin day, the Emperor visited the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple.
s0112.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor visited the Great Chengtian Protecting Sagacity Temple.

s0113.literal: The capital had an earthquake with sound.
s0113.idiomatic: The capital had an earthquake with sound.

s0114.literal: On jimao day, Prince Yeshe Ban was ordered to return to his fief and guard his post.
s0114.idiomatic: On jimao day, Prince Yeshe Ban was ordered to return to his fief and guard his post.

s0115.literal: The Jiang-Zhe surveillance commission impeached vice commissioner Sanbao as vicious, sinister, and disruptive to discipline and regulations — an edict dismissed him.
s0115.idiomatic: The Jiang-Zhe surveillance commission impeached vice commissioner Sanbao as vicious, sinister, and disruptive to discipline and regulations — an edict dismissed him.

s0116.literal: On renwu day, fifty thousand shi of grain was again issued for relief sale to relieve the capital's poor.
s0116.idiomatic: On renwu day, 50,000 shi of grain was again issued for relief sale to relieve the capital's poor.

s0117.literal: On wuzi day, because Tangqishi was ill he went ahead to Shangdu; one thousand ingots of notes for medicine costs were granted.
s0117.idiomatic: On wuzi day, because Tangqishi was ill he went ahead to Shangdu; 1,000 ingots of notes for medicine costs were granted.

s0118.literal: Envoys were dispatched to the place where the Imperial Preceptor dwelt at Sasigiya, proclaiming by pearl-woven patent to his subordinates; four thousand ingots of notes and five thousand bolts each of silks and cloth were still granted and divided among them.
s0118.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to the place where the Imperial Preceptor dwelt at Sasigiya, proclaiming by pearl-woven patent to his subordinates; 4,000 ingots of notes and 5,000 bolts each of silks and cloth were still granted and divided among them.

s0119.literal: Nineteen relay stations including Tieligan, Bulao, and Yebuchen were relieved — two shi of grain per person.
s0119.idiomatic: 19 relay stations including Tieligan, Bulao, and Yebuchen were relieved — 2 shi of grain per person.

s0120.literal: On gengyin day, the imperial procession departed Dadu on a seasonal tour to Shangdu.
s0120.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the imperial procession departed Dadu on a seasonal tour to Shangdu.

s0121.literal: The Shandong Yidu and other places Gold, Silver, Copper, and Iron Intendant Office was established.
s0121.idiomatic: The Shandong Yidu and other places Gold, Silver, Copper, and Iron Intendant Office was established.

s0122.literal: On xinmao day, the Minister of Works seal was again granted to Wan'an Temple monk Yanxiangji.
s0122.idiomatic: On xinmao day, the Minister of Works seal was again granted to Wan'an Temple monk Yanxiangji.

s0123.literal: An edict granted fifty thousand ingots of notes to repair the Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa memorial hall.
s0123.idiomatic: An edict granted 50,000 ingots of notes to repair the Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa memorial hall.

s0124.literal: On renchen day, Court of Imperial Sacrifices academician Wang Zan said: "Everywhere requests to add enfeoffment to spirit temples extend even to illicit shrines.
s0124.idiomatic: On renchen day, Court of Imperial Sacrifices academician Wang Zan said: "Everywhere requests to add enfeoffment to spirit temples extend even to illicit shrines.

s0125.literal: According to the Rites Classic, one who settles the state by labor, dies in diligent service, can ward off great disasters, or can repel great calamities — him they sacrifice.
s0125.idiomatic: According to the Rites Classic, one who settles the state by labor, dies in diligent service, can ward off great disasters, or can repel great calamities — him they sacrifice.

s0126.literal: Spirits not in the canonical sacrifices — hereafter enfeoffment is not permitted.
s0126.idiomatic: Spirits not in the canonical sacrifices — hereafter enfeoffment is not permitted.

s0128.literal: On dingyou day, white rainbows appeared together with the sun, stretching the length of the sky.
s0128.idiomatic: On dingyou day, white rainbows appeared together with the sun, stretching the length of the sky.

s0129.literal: Yan Wuyao, father of Yanzi, was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Qi, posthumous name Wenyu;
s0129.idiomatic: Yan Wuyao, father of Yanzi, was posthumously enfeoffed Duke of Qi, posthumous name Wenyu;

s0130.literal: his mother Lady Qi Jiang as Lady of Qi, posthumous name Duansian;
s0130.idiomatic: his mother Lady Qi Jiang as Lady of Qi, posthumous name Duansian;

s0131.literal: his wife Lady Song Dai as Lady of Yan, posthumous name Zhensu.
s0131.idiomatic: his wife Lady Song Dai as Lady of Yan, posthumous name Zhensu.

s0132.literal: Ganzhou had great hail; Jiangdu and Taixing of Yangzhou, Yunmeng and Yingcheng counties of De'an Prefecture, and Sui, Chen, Kaifeng, Lanyang, Fengqiu, and other counties of Bianliang had floodwaters; the Hutuo River burst; forty-three qing of tuntian at Qingzhou and elsewhere in Hejian were inundated.
s0132.idiomatic: Ganzhou had great hail; Jiangdu and Taixing of Yangzhou, Yunmeng and Yingcheng counties of De'an Prefecture, and Sui, Chen, Kaifeng, Lanyang, Fengqiu, and other counties of Bianliang had floodwaters; the Hutuo River burst; 43 qing of tuntian at Qingzhou and elsewhere in Hejian were inundated.

s0133.literal: Changning Prefecture suffered famine; two thousand four hundred shi of grain was issued for relief sale.
s0133.idiomatic: Changning Prefecture suffered famine; 2,400 shi of grain was issued for relief sale.

s0134.literal: Hangzhou had fire — ninety-one households afflicted; Chizhou had fire — seventy-three households afflicted; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to measure relief.
s0134.idiomatic: Hangzhou had fire — 91 households afflicted; Chizhou had fire — 73 households afflicted; Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered to measure relief.

s0135.literal: Sixth month, on jihai new moon, an edict proclaimed throughout the court and commonwealth the crimes of Yelu Temür and others, and amnestied the realm.
s0135.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jihai new moon, an edict proclaimed throughout the court and commonwealth the crimes of Yelu Temür and others, and amnestied the realm.

s0136.literal: This year's levies of Sichuan Branch Secretariat and this year's commodity tax of Shaanxi Branch Secretariat were remitted.
s0136.idiomatic: This year's levies of Sichuan Branch Secretariat and this year's commodity tax of Shaanxi Branch Secretariat were remitted.

s0137.literal: Duodu, Wang Shixi, Toghan, and others were registered and employed.
s0137.idiomatic: Duodu, Wang Shixi, Toghan, and others were registered and employed.

s0138.literal: On jiyou day, surveillance censor-in-chief Zhao Shi'an was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
s0138.idiomatic: On jiyou day, surveillance censor-in-chief Zhao Shi'an was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

s0139.literal: On guichou day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice separately at the mountains, rivers, and seas.
s0139.idiomatic: On guichou day, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice separately at the mountains, rivers, and seas.

s0140.literal: On wuwu day, fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted to Yunnan Branch Secretariat as public reserve.
s0140.idiomatic: On wuwu day, 50,000 ingots of notes were granted to Yunnan Branch Secretariat as public reserve.

s0141.literal: On jiwei day, Yan Temür said: "Recently Bayan was enfeoffed Prince of Junning and granted a fief at Song Prefecture; now he requests that one prefecture on the Bian shore be chosen and granted.
s0141.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yan Temür said: "Recently Bayan was enfeoffed Prince of Junning and granted a fief at Song Prefecture; now he requests that one prefecture on the Bian shore be chosen and granted.

s0142.literal: " An edict changed the grant to Chen Prefecture.
s0142.idiomatic: " An edict changed the grant to Chen Prefecture.

s0143.literal: On guihai day, associate privy council administrator Yebu'ulun was additionally granted Grand Master of the Palace with the privilege of the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies.
s0143.idiomatic: On guihai day, associate privy council administrator Yebu'ulun was additionally granted Grand Master of the Palace with the privilege of the same ceremonial as the Three Excellencies.

s0144.literal: On yichou day, censorate officials impeached Liaoyang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Saipuding as vulgar and incompetent — he was dismissed.
s0144.idiomatic: On yichou day, censorate officials impeached Liaoyang Branch Secretariat associate administrator Saipuding as vulgar and incompetent — he was dismissed.

s0145.literal: Investigating censor Chen Siqian said: "For inner and outer officials who are not complete in civil and military talent, whose coming forth and going back bear on the realm's safety and peril, and who can rescue difficulty in arms — do not permit bereavement leave and recall to office.
s0145.idiomatic: Investigating censor Chen Siqian said: "For inner and outer officials who are not complete in civil and military talent, whose coming forth and going back bear on the realm's safety and peril, and who can rescue difficulty in arms — do not permit bereavement leave and recall to office.

s0147.literal: Diviners, yin-yang masters, and the like were forbidden to enter the residences of princes, dukes, and great ministers.
s0147.idiomatic: Diviners, yin-yang masters, and the like were forbidden to enter the residences of princes, dukes, and great ministers.

s0148.literal: Jinning and Ji Prefectures had mulberry disasters; Yidu and Jining had great rain; Wuwei and He prefectures had flooding.
s0148.idiomatic: Jinning and Ji Prefectures had mulberry disasters; Yidu and Jining had great rain; Wuwei and He prefectures had flooding.

s0149.literal: Zhang of Yongcheng County, Guide Prefecture, was commended for chastity and integrity.
s0149.idiomatic: Zhang of Yongcheng County, Guide Prefecture, was commended for chastity and integrity.

s0150.literal: Seventh month, on wuchen new moon, Prince Darimashiri and others dispatched envoys presenting tribute tigers and leopards.
s0150.idiomatic: Seventh month, on wuchen new moon, Prince Darimashiri and others dispatched envoys presenting tribute tigers and leopards.

s0151.literal: Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "This province was formerly granted sixty-nine relay patents and four gold round tallies; in Boqu's rebellion they were nearly all lost — we beg they be granted anew.
s0151.idiomatic: Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "This province was formerly granted 69 relay patents and 4 gold round tallies; in Boqu's rebellion they were nearly all lost — we beg they be granted anew.

s0152.literal: " An edict newly granted thirty-two patents and four round tallies, and still investigated and prosecuted those lost.
s0152.idiomatic: " An edict newly granted 32 patents and 4 round tallies, and still investigated and prosecuted those lost.

s0153.literal: On xinwei day, the carriage workshop official garden was granted to Bayan.
s0153.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the carriage workshop official garden was granted to Bayan.

s0154.literal: Three hundred forty-seven officers and men who had campaigned in Yunnan were granted notes and silks in varying amounts.
s0154.idiomatic: 347 officers and men who had campaigned in Yunnan were granted notes and silks in varying amounts.

s0155.literal: Soldiers were mobilized to repair the bridge and road at Willow Grove Sea.
s0155.idiomatic: Soldiers were mobilized to repair the bridge and road at Willow Grove Sea.

s0156.literal: On yihai day, monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the iron banner pole; one hundred taels of gold, one thousand taels of silver, five hundred bolts each of silks and cloth, two thousand bolts of cloth, and ten thousand ingots of notes were bestowed.
s0156.idiomatic: On yihai day, monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the iron banner pole; 100 taels of gold, 1,000 taels of silver, 500 bolts each of silks and cloth, 2,000 bolts of cloth, and 10,000 ingots of notes were bestowed.

s0157.literal: On dingchou day, four hundred sixty-seven households of Mongol troops adrift into Shaanxi were relieved with three months' grain; they were sent back to their dwellings, fifty ingots of notes per household.
s0157.idiomatic: On dingchou day, 467 households of Mongol troops adrift into Shaanxi were relieved with 3 months' grain; they were sent back to their dwellings, 50 ingots of notes per household.

s0158.literal: Huguang Branch Secretariat said: "Li bandits are rampant — we beg three thousand additional troops for deployment.
s0158.idiomatic: Huguang Branch Secretariat said: "Li bandits are rampant — we beg 3,000 additional troops for deployment.

s0159.literal: " An instruction said: "Per the prior edict, urge Yisimusin to advance troops daily.
s0159.idiomatic: " An instruction said: "Per the prior edict, urge Yisimusin to advance troops daily.

s0160.literal: " On renwu day, Jiangxi Branch Secretariat made mother-of-pearl couches and sent them to Yan Temür; an edict granted the craftsmen one bolt each of silks and cloth.
s0160.idiomatic: On renwu day, Jiangxi Branch Secretariat made mother-of-pearl couches and sent them to Yan Temür; an edict granted the craftsmen 1 bolt each of silks and cloth.

s0161.literal: On jiashen day, Yan Temür presented two thousand five hundred Oros.
s0161.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yan Temür presented 2,500 Oros.

s0162.literal: Li Tingrui of Yu Prefecture was commended for filial conduct.
s0162.idiomatic: Li Tingrui of Yu Prefecture was commended for filial conduct.

s0163.literal: On gengyin day, ten thousand ingots of notes were granted; Yan Temür was ordered to divide them among impoverished palace women and consorts of successive reigns.
s0163.idiomatic: On gengyin day, 10,000 ingots of notes were granted; Yan Temür was ordered to divide them among impoverished palace women and consorts of successive reigns.

s0164.literal: On renchen day, Western Regions prince Busayin dispatched Hajiqiyamading to present tribute of seven-jewel crystal and other objects.
s0164.idiomatic: On renchen day, Western Regions prince Busayin dispatched Hajiqiyamading to present tribute of seven-jewel crystal and other objects.

s0165.literal: Mongol commoners and guard units of each command were granted notes and silks in varying amounts; grain relief for five months was still issued.
s0165.idiomatic: Mongol commoners and guard units of each command were granted notes and silks in varying amounts; grain relief for 5 months was still issued.

s0166.literal: On jiawu day, northern frontier prince Ukekten dispatched Nanhu'ri and others to court with tribute.
s0166.idiomatic: On jiawu day, northern frontier prince Ukekten dispatched Nanhu'ri and others to court with tribute.

s0167.literal: Yan Temür said: "Princes Cheche Tu and Shage, formerly convicted and exiled to the southern wilds — we beg compassionate pardon that they return to their original commands.
s0167.idiomatic: Yan Temür said: "Princes Cheche Tu and Shage, formerly convicted and exiled to the southern wilds — we beg compassionate pardon that they return to their original commands.

s0169.literal: Nine hundred households of Zongren Guard soldiers were each granted one ingot of notes.
s0169.idiomatic: 900 households of Zongren Guard soldiers were each granted 1 ingot of notes.

s0170.literal: The people of Teng Prefecture suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of grain was issued for relief sale.
s0170.idiomatic: The people of Teng Prefecture suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain was issued for relief sale.

s0171.literal: Qingdu County suffered great famine; ten thousand ingots of notes from the Hejian salt levy were used for relief.
s0171.idiomatic: Qingdu County suffered great famine; 10,000 ingots of notes from the Hejian salt levy were used for relief.

s0172.literal: Eighth month, on xinchou day, Prince Arighajiri presented thirty Oros and one hundred three gradually registered troops.
s0172.idiomatic: Eighth month, on xinchou day, Prince Arighajiri presented 30 Oros and 103 gradually registered troops.

s0173.literal: Famine refugees of Baodi County in Dadu were relieved with ten thousand shi of grain from the Capital Region transport office.
s0173.idiomatic: Famine refugees of Baodi County in Dadu were relieved with 10,000 shi of grain from the Capital Region transport office.

s0174.literal: On guimao day, Prince Munanzi and Princes Daduhai, Suonan Guanbu, Temür Chi, and Temüder, and others came to court.
s0174.idiomatic: On guimao day, Prince Munanzi and Princes Daduhai, Suonan Guanbu, Temür Chi, and Temüder, and others came to court.

s0175.literal: Two thousand two hundred twenty-nine guardsmen protecting the Shangdu palace were granted twenty-five ingots of notes each.
s0175.idiomatic: 2,229 guardsmen protecting the Shangdu palace were granted 25 ingots of notes each.

s0176.literal: On yisi day, the heaven drum sounded in the northeast.
s0176.idiomatic: On yisi day, the heaven drum sounded in the northeast.

s0177.literal: On bingwu day, officials were dispatched to sacrifice at the altars of soil and grain.
s0177.idiomatic: On bingwu day, officials were dispatched to sacrifice at the altars of soil and grain.

s0178.literal: On dingwei day, rites were performed at the Grand Temple.
s0178.idiomatic: On dingwei day, rites were performed at the Grand Temple.

s0179.literal: Six hundred ninety thousand-odd shi of grain were transported by sea route to the capital.
s0179.idiomatic: 690,000-odd shi of grain were transported by sea route to the capital.

s0180.literal: On jiyou day, Longxi suffered earthquake.
s0180.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Longxi suffered earthquake.

s0181.literal: The Emperor died; his age was twenty-nine; he had reigned five years.
s0181.idiomatic: The Emperor died; his age was 29; he had reigned 5 years.

s0182.literal: On guichou day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
s0182.idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

s0183.literal: First month of the second year of Yuantong, on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor and right chancellor Bayan led civil and military officials to deliberate and submit the exalted posthumous title Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, temple name Wenzong, national-language posthumous title Emperor Jaya'adu — requesting posthumous rites at the southern suburb.
s0183.idiomatic: First month of the second year of Yuantong, on jiyou day, Grand Preceptor and right chancellor Bayan led civil and military officials to deliberate and submit the exalted posthumous title Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, temple name Wenzong, national-language posthumous title Emperor Jaya'adu — requesting posthumous rites at the southern suburb.

s0184.literal: Third month, on jiyou day, he was joined in the Grand Temple.
s0184.idiomatic: Third month, on jiyou day, he was joined in the Grand Temple.

s0185.literal: Sixth month of the sixth year of Later Zhiyuan, because the Emperor plotted treason and caused Mingzong to die with resentment, an edict removed his spirit tablet.
s0185.idiomatic: Sixth month of the sixth year of Later Zhiyuan, because the Emperor plotted treason and caused Mingzong to die with resentment, an edict removed his spirit tablet.

s0187.literal: Formerly, after our imperial grandfather Emperor Wuzong passed away, our grandmother the Grand Empress Dowager was deluded by slanderers, causing our imperial father Emperor Mingzong to be sent out to enfeoffment in Yunnan.
s0187.idiomatic: Formerly, after our imperial grandfather Emperor Wuzong passed away, our grandmother the Grand Empress Dowager was deluded by slanderers, causing our imperial father Emperor Mingzong to be sent out to enfeoffment in Yunnan.

s0188.literal: When Emperor Yingzong was assassinated, orthodox succession was gradually prepared; our imperial father, as Wuzong's legitimate heir, fled to dwell in the northern desert; princes and great ministers with one heart supported and uplifted him, initiating the great enterprise; at that time, because of proximity, Wenzong was first welcomed to temporarily oversee state affairs.
s0188.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong was assassinated, orthodox succession was gradually prepared; our imperial father, as Wuzong's legitimate heir, fled to dwell in the northern desert; princes and great ministers with one heart supported and uplifted him, initiating the great enterprise; at that time, because of proximity, Wenzong was first welcomed to temporarily oversee state affairs.

s0189.literal: Later knowing what heavenly principle and human relations require, under the borrowed name of yielding the throne, the imperial seal was brought up; our imperial father pushed sincerity without doubt and immediately conferred the crown prince's seal upon him.
s0189.idiomatic: Later knowing what heavenly principle and human relations require, under the borrowed name of yielding the throne, the imperial seal was brought up; our imperial father pushed sincerity without doubt and immediately conferred the crown prince's seal upon him.

s0190.literal: Wenzong's evil deepened without repentance; at the moment when he should have gone in person to welcome him, he with his ministers Yelu Buhua, Yili Yali, Mingli Dong'a, and others plotted treason, causing our imperial father to die with resentment as the honored guest on high.
s0190.idiomatic: Wenzong's evil deepened without repentance; at the moment when he should have gone in person to welcome him, he with his ministers Yelu Buhua, Yili Yali, Mingli Dong'a, and others plotted treason, causing our imperial father to die with resentment as the honored guest on high.

s0191.literal: Returning and again assuming the imperial throne, he wished to explain himself to all under heaven, yet spoke of how in a few days the imperial carriage did not proceed.
s0191.idiomatic: Returning and again assuming the imperial throne, he wished to explain himself to all under heaven, yet spoke of how in a few days the imperial carriage did not proceed.

s0192.literal: All within the seas heard of it, and none did not gnash their teeth.
s0192.idiomatic: All within the seas heard of it, and none did not gnash their teeth.

s0193.literal: Moreover he secretly schemed to pass the throne to his son, fabricating wicked words and shifting blame onto Empress Budashiri, saying the Emperor was not Mingzong's son, and thereby caused exile to remote regions.
s0193.idiomatic: Moreover he secretly schemed to pass the throne to his son, fabricating wicked words and shifting blame onto Empress Budashiri, saying the Emperor was not Mingzong's son, and thereby caused exile to remote regions.

s0194.literal: The great enterprise of the ancestors nearly did not continue.
s0194.idiomatic: The great enterprise of the ancestors nearly did not continue.

s0195.literal: Inwardly harboring shame, he then killed Yili Yali to stop mouths.
s0195.idiomatic: Inwardly harboring shame, he then killed Yili Yali to stop mouths.

s0196.literal: Heaven did not protect him, and death-punishment soon descended.
s0196.idiomatic: Heaven did not protect him, and death-punishment soon descended.

s0197.literal: Aunt Empress Budashiri, relying on her power and flame, did not clarify the heir of the brilliant imperial father but rashly established the infant younger brother Yijianzhenban, who again did not complete a year; the princes and great ministers by worth and seniority supported the Emperor to the throne.
s0197.idiomatic: Aunt Empress Budashiri, relying on her power and flame, did not clarify the heir of the brilliant imperial father but rashly established the infant younger brother Yijianzhenban, who again did not complete a year; the princes and great ministers by worth and seniority supported the Emperor to the throne.

s0198.literal: Great affairs of state that did not proceed from self — how could they be enumerated one by one.
s0198.idiomatic: Great affairs of state that did not proceed from self — how could they be enumerated one by one.

s0199.literal: Whenever reflecting that governing must be rooted in utmost filial piety, and affairs should first be rectifying the person — relying on heaven's spirit, powerful traitors were removed; utmost filial piety and rectification of name cannot be delayed again; eternally considering the boundless grace of nurturing, how could one bear to forget the duty of irreconcilable hatred.
s0199.idiomatic: Whenever reflecting that governing must be rooted in utmost filial piety, and affairs should first be rectifying the person — relying on heaven's spirit, powerful traitors were removed; utmost filial piety and rectification of name cannot be delayed again; eternally considering the boundless grace of nurturing, how could one bear to forget the duty of irreconcilable hatred.

s0200.literal: Past crimes cannot all be punished to death; he ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to remove Tugh Temür's spirit tablet from the temple.
s0200.idiomatic: Past crimes cannot all be punished to death; he ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to remove Tugh Temür's spirit tablet from the temple.
